header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. From the 2026 Form 1040N-ES and cross-checked against the draft 2026 Form 1040N and 2026 Tax Calculation Schedule (drafts dated 8/17/2026). For 2026 the third and fourth statutory brackets share the 4.55% rate under LB 754 (statutory break points $39,900 single / $79,800 MFJ / $59,160 HOH are merged here). The 2026 legislative session did not pause the scheduled cut. Standard deduction: $8,850 single/MFS, $17,700 MFJ, $12,950 HOH; additional amount for 65+/blind $2,050 if unmarried, $1,700 per married spouse. Personal exemption credit $176 per exemption (including dependents), nonrefundable. Social Security benefits included in federal AGI are fully excluded. No general pension/IRA exclusion; military retirement is 100% excluded.
